current_observable.question: Does a synthetic provider credential remain confined to the explicit ephemeral provider-config input and outbound provider transport headers, with no leakage into provider JSON bodies, CLI output, runtime results, receipts, completion evidence, persistent SQLite/state files, workspace/repository files, or acceptance artifacts?

observable_12_falsifiers: credential canary appears in provider request JSON body
credential canary appears in CLI stdout or stderr
credential canary appears in deterministic runtime result or governed ToolReceipt
credential canary appears in persisted completion evidence or SQLite/state storage
credential canary appears in workspace/repository files or acceptance artifacts
configured credential canary is not observed in any outbound provider HTTP header on actual provider requests
allowed_secret_locus: ephemeral disposable provider-config input before deletion
outbound provider transport header observed only by the local deterministic stub

known_harness_failures.detail: the first probe assumed the configured @cline/agents credential must appear specifically as Authorization: Bearer; the provider transport was reached twice, but that exact header shape was not observed. The invocation did not prove a secret leak or a dropped credential. A bounded diagnostic now scans all outbound header values for the canary and reports header names only.
